newsitem.title: USA: Paging Network sees Q3 matching estimates.
newsitem.headline: Paging Network sees Q3 matching estimates.

text.p: Paging Network Inc said on Tuesday it expects third quarter results to be in line with analysts' estimates. It projected revenues of about $180 million and operating cash flow of about $65 million.
The company did not project earnings. According to First Call, analysts expect a loss of about $0.12 a share.
Paging Network also said it had added about 562,000 new subscribers to the service during the third quarter.
The company said it decided to offer preliminary results because it is considering a private debt offering.
Complete third quarter results are expected to be released on October 24.
Paging Network is a wireless messaging company.
